   ANNUAL REPORT

                   Annual Report 2024 年報
            China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited (the “Company”;
            stock code: 2319) and its subsidiaries (collectively the
            “Group” or “Mengniu”) mainly manufacture and distribute
            quality dairy products in China. It is one of the leading dairy
            product manufacturers in China, with MENGNIU as its core
            brand. Mengniu offers diversified products including liquid

CORPORATE   milk products, ice cream, milk formula and cheese. Mengniu
            ranked ninth in the 2024 “Global Dairy Top 20” list published
 PROFILE    by Rabobank. As of 31 December 2024, the Group’s annual
            dairy production capacity amounted to around 14 million
 公司簡介       tons. In March 2014, Mengniu became a Hang Seng Index
            constituent, making it the first blue chip Chinese dairy
            product manufacturer. Mengniu’s MSCI ESG rating of AA is
            the highest rating received by a comprehensive dairy
            company in China. Mengniu is a constituent of the Hang
            Seng Corporate Sustainability Index, Hang Seng (Mainland
            and HK) Corporate Sustainability Index, Hang Seng
            Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index and HSI ESG
            Enhanced Select Index.

            中國蒙牛乳業有限公司（「本公司」；股份代號：2319）及其子
            公司（統稱「本集團」或「蒙牛」）主要於中國生產及銷售優質乳
            製品。憑藉其主要品牌蒙牛 ，蒙牛已成為中國領先的乳製品
            生產商之一。蒙牛提供多元化的產品，包括液態奶、冰淇淋、
            奶粉及奶酪產品。蒙牛於荷蘭合作銀行公佈的二零二四年「全
            球乳業二十強」中排名第九。截至二零二四年十二月三十一
            日，本集團乳製品的年生產能力約1,400萬噸。二零一四年三
            月，蒙牛獲納入恒生指數成份股，成為首家中國乳製品企業
            藍籌股。蒙牛MSCI ESG評級為AA級，是中國綜合型乳製品
            企業獲得的最高評級，並入選恒生可持續發展企業指數、恒
            生內地及香港可持續發展企業指數、恒生可持續發展企業基
            準指數及恒指ESG增強精選指數。

        CEO’S
        STATEMENT
        總裁致辭
China’s dairy industry faced multiple challenges in 2024, including      二零二四年，中國乳製品行業在消費需求不及預
softer-than-expected consumer demand, intensified competition,           期與行業競爭加劇的多重變局中開啟新局。面對
raw milk supply and demand imbalances, accelerated channel               原奶需供矛盾、渠道重塑加速、品類多元化不足
restructuring, and insufficient product diversification. Despite these   等挑戰，蒙牛始終以國民健康需求為核心，緊抓
headwinds, we remain committed to prioritising the health needs          國民健康意識不斷提升和消費潛能不斷釋放的機
of consumers and capitalized on the opportunities created by             遇，通過戰略升級與創新驅動，通過品牌引領、
rising health awareness to drive innovation, strategic upgrades,         研發創新、數智轉型，不斷打造新產品、提供新
and unlock consumer potential. Through brand driven, R&D                 場景、拓展新賽道，打磨新質生產力，引領行業
innovation, and digital transformation, we continued to develop          向高質量、高價值方向轉型。
new products, create new consumption scenarios, expand into
new segments, and refine our new-quality productive forces to
steer the industry toward high-quality, high-value development.

We actively deepened lean operations and empowered our                   我們積極深化精益化運營，通過數智化賦能，全
business through digital transformation, enhancing operational           面提升蒙牛運營效率及盈利能力。通過整合上下
efficiency and profitability. By integrating upstream and                游資源，優化合作夥伴效能，蒙牛持續改善供應
downstream resources and optimizing partner performance, we              鏈效率，顯著提升乳業產業鏈韌性，為行業樹立
significantly improved supply chain efficiency, bolstering the           了系統化、一體化發展的標桿。
resilience of the dairy industry chain and setting a new
benchmark for systematic and integrated development.

                  which the hedged expected future cash flows affect                期間的重新分類調整。倘對沖不再符
                  profit or loss. If the hedge no longer meets the criteria         合對沖會計處理標準或對沖工具被出
                  for hedge accounting or the hedging instrument is                 售、到期、終止或行使時，則往後終
                  sold, expires, is terminated or is exercised, then                止使用對沖會計處理。當對沖會計處
                  hedge accounting is discontinued prospectively. When              理已終止使用，對沖儲備中累計的數
                  hedge accounting is discontinued, the amount that                 額仍為權益，直至交易發生，並根據
                  has been accumulated in the hedging reserve remains               上述政策確認。
                  in equity until the transaction occurs and it is
                  recognised in accordance with the above policy.

            swaps match the interest payments and the principal                          行貸款協議的本金付款相匹配。本集團為
            payments of the bank loan agreements. The Group has                          對沖關係設定1：1的對沖比率，原因為利
            established a hedge ratio of 1:1 for the hedging relationships               率互換合約的相關風險與已對沖風險成分
            as the underlying risks of the interest rate swaps are                       基本相同。為計量對沖有效性，本集團採
            basically the same as the hedged risk components. To                         用假設衍生工具法，並將已對沖風險產生
            measure the hedge effectiveness, the Group uses the                          的對沖工具公允值變動與已對沖項目公允
            hypothetical derivative method and compares the changes in                   值變動進行比較。
            the fair value of the hedging instruments against the changes
            in fair value of the hedged items attributable to the hedged
            risks.

          The share award scheme of the Company was adopted by                   本公司股票獎勵計劃於二零一三年三月
          the board on 26 March 2013 (the “Adoption Date”). The                  二十六日（「採納日期」）獲董事會採納。股
          purpose of the share award scheme is to provide an                     票獎勵計劃旨在獎勵參與者繼續為本集團
          incentive to encourage the participants for the continual              的經營及發展作出貢獻。
          operation and development of the Group.

          Subject to the terms of the share award scheme and the                 根據股票獎勵計劃條款及上市規則，董事
          Listing Rules, the board may at any time make an offer to              會可隨時向任何合資格人士作出要約，由
          any eligible person whom it may in its absolute discretion             合資格人士絕對酌情選擇接納董事會決定
          select to accept the grant of an award over such a number              授出的有關股份數目之獎勵（「參與者」）。
          of shares as it may determine (the “Participants”). Existing           股票獎勵計劃的獨立受託人（「受託人」）以
          shares of the Company will be purchased by an                          本集團出資的現金於市場上購買本公司現
          independent trustee (the “Trustee”) of the share award                 有股份，及以信託形式代相關參與者持有，
          scheme from the market out of cash contributed by the                  直至該等股份根據股票獎勵計劃的條文歸
          Group and be held in trust for the relevant Participants until         屬於相關參與者為止。已授出及由受託人
          such shares are vested with the relevant Participants in               持有直至歸屬的本公司股份稱為庫存股份，
          accordance with the provisions of the share award scheme.              而各庫存股份應指本公司一股普通股。
          The shares of the Company granted and held by the
          trustee until vesting are referred to as the treasury shares
          and each treasury share shall represent one ordinary share

                      hierarchy as defined in IFRS/HKFRS 13, Fair                          公允值計量 的定義分類為三個
                      value measurement . The level into which a fair                      層 級。公 允 值 計 量 的 層 級 分 類
                      value measurement is classified is determined                        乃參考下列估值方式採用數據
                      with reference to the observability and                              的可觀察程度及重要性而定：
                      significance of the inputs used in the valuation
                      technique as follows:

                      •   Level 1 valuations:    Fair value measured using only Level 1 inputs i.e. unadjusted quoted
                                                 prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities at the
                                                 measurement date
                          第一級估值：                 僅使用第一級輸入數據（即相同資產或負債於計量日在活躍市場的未經調
                                                 整報價）計量的公允值

                      •   Level 2 valuations:    Fair value measured using Level 2 inputs i.e. observable inputs which fail
                                                 to meet Level 1, and not using significant unobservable inputs.
                                                 Unobservable inputs are inputs for which market data are not available
                          第二級估值：                 使用第二級輸入數據（即未能符合第一級標準的可觀察的輸入數據，且未
                                                 採用重大不可觀察輸入數據）計量的公允值。不可觀察輸入數據為無市場
                                                 數據的輸入數據

                      •   Level 3 valuations:    Fair value measured using significant unobservable inputs
                          第三級估值：                 使用重大不可觀察輸入數據計量的公允值
